hunk_reviews.source_judgment: The original reset repair clears selected state inside the low-level native-value updater for every falsy display. The current owned updater instead preserves non-null values and performs quiet deselection in _assignOptionValue when the actual model is nullish. This retains programmatic reactive reset while applying the latercf868 refinement. The before/after originals reproduce the reset defect and show why literal falsy cleanup would regress0/false/empty displays.

The added actual Angular regression first selects an option, then resets the reactive FormControl and checks both null model and deselected option. The current legacy suite only checks its typed text resets. Preserve that existing text assertion and add a real selection/reset cycle, including no option-selection emission. Source FormControl callbacks support the decision but do not execute this native regression.

decision: The complete two-file/two-hunk reactive-reset change is present in the owned legacy trigger. Programmatic null or undefined clears the previous selected option quietly through the owned value-assignment path. The later null-only condition is retained: zero, false, empty string and an empty display result must not be treated as a missing model. The original intermediate falsy-display guard is therefore not copied. The strengthened existing native reset test first selects an actual option, then requires silent selected-state cleanup and exactly one null CVA write. Current whole-method Forms/RxJS diagnostics support this source judgment; actual Angular DI/rendering, packed behavior and runtime/compiler/RxJS/peer floors remain separate mandatory executions.
source_protocol_scope: Complete patched owned, tagged, both retained minimum peer and original before/after prototype methods. Real FormControl value-accessor callbacks and RxJS closing/option-change streams; explicit synthetic panel/option/overlay receivers and controlled render notifications. Visibility, close teardown, focus/open eligibility, sizing, label, modal ownership and key-manager hooks are substituted. Constructors, field initializers, Angular rendering/DI, real DOM outside-click/geometry, packed artifact, runtime/compiler/RxJS/peer-floor execution are excluded.
